## Figure 1. Cohort Structure and Amyloid Burden

### Methods

The cleaned, imputed analysis table (`omics_aibl_demo_clean_imputed.csv`) was used for Figure 1. Sex and amyloid labels were harmonized to Female/Male and amyloid-normal/amyloid-high groups before plotting. Panel A displays Centiloid distributions by sex within amyloid-normal and amyloid-high groups using raincloud plots with individual observations, half-density summaries, and boxplots. Panel C evaluates the association between age and Centiloid separately by sex using linear regression and Pearson correlation.

### Results

The final figure summarizes the 90-participant modelling cohort, including 50 women and 40 men. Amyloid status was balanced by sex: women included 31 amyloid-normal and 19 amyloid-high participants, and men included 24 amyloid-normal and 16 amyloid-high participants. Centiloid values separated the amyloid-normal and amyloid-high groups cleanly, while within-status comparisons showed no strong sex imbalance in amyloid burden. Age was not strongly correlated with Centiloid in women or men, supporting subsequent sex-stratified modelling rather than age-driven separation.

### Figure Legend

**Figure 1. Participant amyloid burden and age associations.** Panel A shows Centiloid distributions by sex within amyloid-normal and amyloid-high groups. Points represent individual participants; half-eye densities and boxplots summarize the distribution. The dashed horizontal line indicates the approximate amyloid-positivity threshold. Panel C shows sex-stratified associations between age and Centiloid with linear regression fits and Pearson correlation annotations.

```{r}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
dir.create("../plots", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

omics_df <- read.csv("../preprocessed_data/omics_aibl_demo_clean_imputed.csv", na.strings = c("", "NA"), check.names = FALSE)
# omics_df <- read.csv("../preprocessed_data/omics_aibl_demo_imputed_clean.csv", na.strings = c("", "NA"), check.names = FALSE)

normalise_sex <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  ifelse(x %in% c("0", "Female"), "Female",
         ifelse(x %in% c("1", "Male"), "Male", x))
}

normalise_label <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  ifelse(x %in% c("0", "N"), "N",
         ifelse(x %in% c("1", "H"), "H", x))
}

omics_df$Demographic.Sex <- factor(normalise_sex(omics_df$Demographic.Sex), levels = c("Female", "Male"))
omics_df$label <- factor(normalise_label(omics_df$label), levels = c("N", "H"))
```


panel A - Raincloud
```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(ggdist)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)  # For combining plots
library(ggpubr)     # For stat_compare_means

# Define color palette (keeping your original colors)
sex_colors <- c("Female" = "#b57979", "Male" = "#576fa0")

# ============================================================================
# PANEL A: Raincloud Plot - Centiloid by Sex & Amyloid Status (Separated)
# ============================================================================

# Prepare data
omics_df <- omics_df %>%
  mutate(
    Sex_Amyloid = paste(Demographic.Sex, label, sep = "_"),
    Sex_Amyloid = factor(Sex_Amyloid, 
                         levels = c("Female_N", "Female_H", "Male_N", "Male_H"))
  )

# Create base plotting function to ensure consistency
create_raincloud_plot <- function(data, group_label, show_y_label = TRUE) {
  p <- ggplot(data, aes(x = Demographic.Sex, y = Centiloid, fill = Demographic.Sex)) +
    # Individual points (jittered)
    geom_jitter(aes(color = Demographic.Sex), 
                width = 0.05, alpha = 0.5, size = 0.9) +
    # Half-eye density plot
    stat_halfeye(width = 0.2, .width = 0,
                 justification = -0.79,
                 point_colour = NA, alpha = 0.6) +
    # Boxplot
    geom_boxplot(position = position_nudge(x = 0.14),
                 width = 0.1, outlier.size = 0,
                 outlier.alpha = 0, alpha = 0.6) +
    # Statistical comparison
    stat_compare_means(
      comparisons = list(c("Female", "Male")),
      label = "p.signif",
      method = "wilcox.test",
      exact = FALSE,

      # hjust = 0.5,
      # size = 4
      label.y = max(data$Centiloid, na.rm = TRUE),
      size = 4
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = sex_colors) +
    scale_color_manual(values = sex_colors) +
    labs(
      x = "Sex",
      y = if(show_y_label) "Centiloid Level" else "",
      title = group_label
    ) +
    theme(
      axis.ticks.x = element_line(linewidth = 0, color = "black"),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "white"),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "#cfcece", linewidth = 0.25),
      panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
      panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1),
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 13),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 13)
    )
  
  return(p)
}

# Filter data for Normal and High groups
normal_data <- omics_df %>% filter(label == "N")
high_data <- omics_df %>% filter(label == "H")

# Create individual plots
panel_a_normal <- create_raincloud_plot(
  normal_data, 
  "Amyloid-normal",
  show_y_label = TRUE
)

# Add threshold line to Normal plot if needed
panel_a_normal <- panel_a_normal +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 20, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.8) +
  annotate("text", x = 0.6, y = 20, label = "Approx. threshold = 20", 
           hjust = 0, vjust = -0.5, size = 3.5, color = "grey30")

panel_a_high <- create_raincloud_plot(
  high_data, 
  "Amyloid-high",
  show_y_label = TRUE
)

# Add threshold line to High plot if needed
panel_a_high <- panel_a_high +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 20, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.8) +
  annotate("text", x = 0.6, y = 20, label = "Approx. threshold = 20", 
           hjust = 0, vjust = -0.5, size = 3.5, color = "grey30")

# Combine plots side by side
panel_a_combined <- panel_a_normal + panel_a_high +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "A. Centiloid Distribution by Sex and Amyloid Status",
    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, hjust = 0.5))
  )

# Display combined plot
panel_a_combined

# # Save individual plots
# ggsave("../plots/Figure1_PanelA_Normal.pdf", panel_a_normal, width = 5, height = 6, units = "in")
# ggsave("../plots/Figure1_PanelA_High.pdf", panel_a_high, width = 5, height = 6, units = "in")

# Save combined plot
ggsave("../plots/Figure1_PanelAB_Combined.pdf", panel_a_combined, width = 10, height = 6, units = "in")

```
Panel C - Age and Centiloid
```{r}
sex_colors <- c("Female" = "#b57979", "Male" = "#576fa0")

# cor_female <- cor.test(omics_df$Age[omics_df$Demographic.Sex == "Female"], 
#                        omics_df$Centiloid[omics_df$Demographic.Sex == "Female"])
# cor_male <- cor.test(omics_df$Age[omics_df$Demographic.Sex == "Male"], 
#                      omics_df$Centiloid[omics_df$Demographic.Sex == "Male"])
cor_female <- cor.test(omics_df$Age[omics_df$Demographic.Sex == "Female"],
                       omics_df$Centiloid[omics_df$Demographic.Sex == "Female"])
cor_male <- cor.test(omics_df$Age[omics_df$Demographic.Sex == "Male"],
                     omics_df$Centiloid[omics_df$Demographic.Sex == "Male"])

panel_c <- ggplot(omics_df, aes(x = Age, y = Centiloid, color = Demographic.Sex, fill = Demographic.Sex)) +
  # Add regression lines with confidence intervals
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, alpha = 0.2, linewidth = 1.2) +
  # Add points
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.6) +
  # Add correlation annotations
  annotate("text", x = min(omics_df$Age, na.rm = TRUE) + 1, 
           y = max(omics_df$Centiloid, na.rm = TRUE),
           label = sprintf("Female: r = %.2f, p = %.3f", 
                          cor_female$estimate, cor_female$p.value),
           hjust = 0, size = 5, color = sex_colors["Female"]) +
  annotate("text", x = min(omics_df$Age, na.rm = TRUE) + 1, 
           y = max(omics_df$Centiloid, na.rm = TRUE) - 10,
           label = sprintf("Male: r = %.2f, p = %.3f", 
                          cor_male$estimate, cor_male$p.value),
           hjust = 0, size = 5, color = sex_colors["Male"]) +
  scale_color_manual(values = sex_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = sex_colors) +
  labs(
    x = "Age (Years)",
    y = "Centiloid Level",
    title = "C. Relationship Between Age and Centiloid Level by Sex",
    color = "Sex",
    fill = "Sex"
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "white"),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12)
  )

panel_c
ggsave("../plots/Figure1_PanelC.pdf", panel_c, width = 10, height = 6, units = "in")
```
